title: Provider Translation: Add tool schema conversion
description: Convert JSON Schema tool definitions to each provider's format: OpenAI functions, Anthropic tools, Google functionDeclarations.

title: Provider Translation: Implement OpenAI response builder
description: Convert canonical streaming events back to OpenAI SSE format (data: {...}). This is what clients receive.

title: Provider Translation: Implement Anthropic response transformer
description: Parse Anthropic SSE events (content_block_start, content_block_delta, etc.) into canonical StreamEvents. Handle thinking blocks with signatures.

title: Provider Translation: Handle provider-specific compat quirks
description: Implement quirks: Mistral 9-char tool IDs, developer vs system role, max_tokens field names, empty content handling, tool result name field.

title: Provider Translation: Implement Google response transformer
description: Parse Google GenerateContent stream into canonical StreamEvents. Handle thought parts with thoughtSignature.

title: Provider Translation: Implement Anthropic request transformer
description: Transform canonical Context to Anthropic Messages API format. Handle x-api-key header, anthropic-version, cache_control, and tool schema conversion.

title: Provider Translation: Define canonical message types
description: Define canonical types: UserMessage, AssistantMessage, ToolCall, ToolResult, ThinkingContent, TextContent, ImageContent. These form the foundation for cross-provider translation.

title: Provider Translation: Implement cross-provider message transform
description: When messages from one provider are sent to another: convert thinking blocks to <thinking> text tags, filter orphan tool calls without results.

title: Provider Translation: Implement Google request transformer
description: Transform canonical Context to Google GenerateContent format. Handle role mapping (assistant->model), systemInstruction, and functionDeclarations.

title: Provider Translation: Implement OpenAI request parser
description: Parse incoming /v1/chat/completions requests into canonical format. This is the input format clients send.

title: Provider Translation: Define canonical Context struct
description: Define Context struct with system_prompt, messages Vec, and tools Vec. This is the unified format all providers translate to/from.
